### Added

- (agent-platform) [Edit an agent applied from git in commit mode](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2836) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Where agent-manager supports pull requests, the Edit agent page edits an agent applied from git: the review shows the dry run, and `Commit` opens a pull request, named with its repository, number and author. Creating and deleting an agent link their pull requests too.
- (agent-platform) [Offer Edit for an agent applied from git](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2837) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On the page of an agent applied from git, `Edit agent…` in the actions menu, `Add skills` on the Skills tab and `Edit agent` on a failed agent lead to the Edit agent page in commit mode, where agent-manager supports pull requests.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Sessions loads, not empty, while a failed read retries](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2834) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After a failed read in a background tab, the Sessions page shows its loading state until the retry answers, instead of `No sessions found.`
- (gs) [About card and Edit button agree on the auto-upgrade mode](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2841) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a deployment's page, the About card's `Auto-upgrade` and the edit template that `Edit` pre-fills agree: a range such as `>=5.12.0 <6.0.0` reads as `Minor and patch` in both, instead of a custom version range on edit.
- (roadmap) [Read every board item per column, not the first 50](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2840) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The roadmap board (Hive's Roadmap tab) shows every card of a column, and counts them, instead of stopping at 50. A column that still comes back cut short shows an error instead of part of its cards.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.93.1...v2.94.0
